en-US.author: Luis Pater
en-US.description: Wrap Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Codex as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT 5 model through API
en-US.longDescription:
A proxy server that provides OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API interfaces for CLI.
It now also supports OpenAI Codex (GPT models) and Claude Code via OAuth.
so you can use local or multi‑account CLI access with OpenAI‑compatible clients and SDKs.
Now, We added the first Chinese provider: Qwen Code.
en-US.name: CLI Proxy API
en-US.releaseNotes:
Linux release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>.tar.gz is the default Linux build. It supports dynamic library plugins and is built against a GLIBC 2.17 baseline.
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>_no-plugin.tar.gz is the portable Linux build for musl-based or older systems such as OpenWrt. It does not support dynamic library plugins.
FreeBSD release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_freebsd_aarch64_no-plugin.tar.gz is the FreeBSD arm64 build. It is built without CGO and does not support dynamic library plugins.
Changelog
- fix(claude): disable default upstream connection reuse and revert post-stream draining (2c5b01f4)
- fix(pluginhost): support credential-scoped rate limit errors from plugin executors (14e57717)
- fix(auth): share and migrate model cooldowns across equivalent model spellings (098af7d5)
- perf(antigravity): skip reasoning replay KV for symmetric gemini/interactions protocols (f36b195e)
- fix(home): preserve fork kind in home dispatch (0561334f)
- feat(auth): compensate weighted routing for sticky sessions (d2045150)
- perf(auth): compact weighted round-robin pools (e479ab12)
- Merge pull request #7377 from router-for-me/home (aa3fe8ea)
- fix(claude): recognize native client user-agent extensions (542a525f)
- fix(claude): retain request fields with stabilized client profiles (59304330)
- Merge pull request #7375 from router-for-me/fix/claude-code-user-agent-extensions (d1218c0a)
- fix(auth): account pinned traffic in bare weighted routing (e84d4836)
- feat(gemini): support asymmetric thoughtSignature replay KV across Gemini executors (cc95661c)
- perf(cache): eliminate double base64 encoding for reasoning replay KV arrays (00c6ae82)
- Merge pull request #7374 from sususu98/feat/asymmetric-signature-replay (bce665d7)
- feat(home): report reused dispatch turns in usage (216f2947)
- fix(claude): materialize top-level cache_control in cloaked requests (beb43359)
- fix(executor): stabilize Codex refresh and websocket tests under CPU contention (23e31fe2)
- Merge pull request #7380 from router-for-me/auth (2c4322c7)
- fix(logging): skip request error dumps for unrouted 404 responses (4b3f2c7e)
What's Changed
- feat(auth): compensate weighted routing for sticky sessions by @hkfires in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7377
- fix(claude): preserve native Claude Code requests with UA extensions by @GavinKung in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7375
- feat(gemini): support asymmetric thoughtSignature replay KV across Gemini executors and eliminate KV double base64 encoding by @sususu98 in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7374
- feat(auth): account for pinned and reused traffic in weighted routing by @hkfires in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7380
Full Changelog: https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/compare/v8.0.61...v8.0.62

zh-CN.description: 封装 Gemini CLI 和 ChatGPT Codex 为兼容 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 的 API 服务，让您通过 API 畅享免费的 Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 GPT 5 模型
zh-CN.longDescription:
一个为 CLI 提供 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 兼容 API 接口的代理服务器。
现已支持通过 OAuth 登录接入 OpenAI Codex（GPT 系列）和 Claude Code。
可与本地或多账户方式配合，使用任何 OpenAI 兼容的客户端与 SDK。
现在，我们添加了第一个中国提供商：Qwen Code。
